title: Convolution with a smooth compactly supported kernel is smooth and its Laplacian is the convolution with the kernel's Laplacian
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f φ : Euclid n → ℝ), LocallyIntegrable f → (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ m φ) → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ m (fun x => ∫ y, f y * φ (x - y))) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid n, ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun x => ∫ y, f y * φ (x - y)) x ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = ∫ y, f y * ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 φ (x - y) ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)]
